cases.purpose: Validate PSU firmware upgrade and downgrade through the approved BMC HPM path across the defined N and N-1 cycles, with version readback, PSU health, and system power-cycle evidence.
preconditions: The owner supplies exact vendor-supported N and N-1 PSU firmware images, target PSU slot/serial mapping, compatibility rules, checksums, and the required update order; the source does not define what N means.
A maintenance window, power redundancy/load approval, BMC HTTPS access, authorized credentials, vendor recovery/rollback procedure, and a known-good host/BMC baseline are available.
The platform confirms that the HPM page and PSU update path support the target PSU model and both upgrade and downgrade operations without flashing an incompatible component.
pre_check_commands: Using read-only access, record BMC reachability, PSU slot/serial and current firmware versions, BMC/host health, PSU redundancy/load, sensor inventory, SEL, and timestamps; do not clear logs or expose credentials.
Validate the image checksum and target compatibility before any flash, and document the expected version after each N or N-1 operation and power cycle.
safety_checks: Do not start a PSU flash or downgrade without the exact approved image, compatibility confirmation, maintenance window, and recovery plan; never guess N/N-1 or reuse an image for an unverified PSU model.

Do not flash multiple power paths in a way that removes redundancy, interrupt a running update, or power-cycle while the BMC/PSU update state is incomplete; stop on timeout, reset loop, unexpected power loss, or management loss.
Use HTTPS and a secret-safe credential mechanism; do not place passwords in command text or collected logs, and preserve BMC/SEL evidence rather than clearing it.

Vendor-approved PSU firmware images for N and N-1 with checksums
Vendor/BMC HPM firmware update and rollback procedure
cases.test_command: A user-authorized operator performs the PSU firmware update or downgrade in the BMC HPM page with the approved image and waits for the documented completion state. Repeat only for the explicitly defined N/N-1 sequence and stop when the prior cycle is stable.

Per-cycle BMC/HPM completion evidence and read-only PSU firmware-version, sensor, SEL, BMC, host, and power-redundancy output with timestamps.
Successful controlled power-cycle and final recovery, plus any rollback or vendor recovery record without exposed credentials.
